title: Story verification from verified/master

story.i_want_to: judge a chg-mode story's CI evidence from the trunk verifier
story.so_that: verification reads the one sha that landed and was verified

acceptance_criteria.description: For a :chg source, the CI-evidence input passes only when the current binding's landed sha — the TRUNK commit of its newest applied `landed` event, `data.merge_sha`, never the envelope `sha` (the revision commit, which is US-47.5's to certify) — is an ancestor of, or equal to, verified/master (compare by sha) and no reverted event follows it. That a review_records row names the landed revision is US-47.5's verify gate (AC-47.5.5, 409 chg_review_not_for_landed_revision), which already runs on every verify path; it is not re-implemented here.

A compare call that times out or errors answers unevaluated with Retry-After; it is never read as a pass. A 404 (no verified/master ref yet, or the trunk commit not on the forge yet) is unevaluated too, never a refusal: chg has not verified it yet, which is not a failure of the story.
Every other verify gate is unchanged.

test_cases.name: not yet verified
preconditions: landed sha not an ancestor of verified/master (mocked forge)

technical_notes: Every forge call authenticates with the tenant's own GitHub token (#936).

The ancestor check reuses `PullRequestSource.contains?/3` (`GET /repos/:repo/compare/<merge_sha>...verified/master`): the status describes the HEAD relative to the BASE, so `ahead` or `identical` means merge_sha is an ancestor of verified/master, and `behind` or `diverged` means it is not.

The forge read runs BEFORE the verify transaction; the answer is applied under the story lock only to the landing it was made for (a newer landing in between is unevaluated `landing_changed`). A local `trunk_verified_sha == merge_sha` is not taken as the answer: the ref is.
